item.title: Plenty Of Essentials v1.0.0 Add-On
item.creator: Owls Cubed
item.description: One pack. 50+ features. Waystones, gravestones, magnet, jump pads, builder & navigation wands, vein miner, auto-replanting crops, dynamic light helmets, land claims, holograms, info HUD, slime boots, decorative stickers, structure cannon — every quality of life upgrade you used to install separately, now bundled and built to work together. Smooth out survival.

faqEntries.heading: Do I need cheats to use the commands?
faqEntries.content: No. Every command works with cheats off, and all of them except /ban, /pardon and /permissions are open to every player by default.

faqEntries.heading: How do I stop other players from using /gm or /god?
faqEntries.content: As an operator, type /permissions and switch any command or menu section to Operators. The change applies to the whole world.

faqEntries.heading: Where are the settings?
faqEntries.content: Use the Main Essentials Menu or type /settings. Add a section name, like /settings health_bar, to open it directly.

faqEntries.heading: How do I protect my base?
faqEntries.content: Place a Region Claim Flag to claim the chunk and add more with the Region Expander. Visitors cannot build, break or open anything there, and Locks keep your chests and doors to yourself.

faqEntries.heading: How do I add friends to my region?
faqEntries.content: Use your flag while they are online, open Members and pick a role. Friends can open containers and doors but cannot build or break until you allow it in Permissions.

faqEntries.heading: What happens to my items when I die?
faqEntries.content: They go into a gravestone with your XP, and a Death Waypoint shows how far it is. Break the gravestone to get everything back, or type /back to return to where you died.

item.howToTitle: Getting Started with Plenty Of Essentials

howToEntries.content:
Every player gets the Essentials Tutorial Book on first join, and the first player in the world also gets the Main Essentials Menu. Use the book to turn pages, sneak and use to go back, or double-tap sneak with it to jump to a topic. Lost them? Craft the book from Lapis Lazuli, a Book and a Copper Ingot, and the menu from 4 Iron Ingots and a Compass.

Settings: open the Main Essentials Menu or type /settings. Auto-sort, best tools, capitators, replanting and the Info Board are personal; health bars, damage numbers, gravestones, dynamic light and the Action Logger apply to the whole world.

Commands: no cheats needed. /sethome, /home, /setwarp, /warp, /spawn, /back, /rtp, /kit, /heal, /gm and more work for everyone by default; only /ban, /pardon and /permissions need operator rights. Operators can restrict any command or menu section with /permissions.

Teleports: /tpa to <player> asks to go to them, /tpa here <player> asks them to come, and they reply with /tpa ok or /tpa no within a minute (or use /tpamenu). /back returns you to where you were before your last add-on teleport or to where you died.

Regions: place a Region Claim Flag to claim its chunk and name the region, then add neighboring chunks with the Region Expander. Use the flag to add Owners, Friends or Enemies, choose what each role may do, and toggle PvP, monster spawning and explosions. Each player can create one region.

Locks: use a Lock on a chest, door, gate or other container to make it yours. Only you and operators can open or break it; use the Lock again to remove it.

Waystones: placing one creates a warp. Use it to rename it or travel to any other warp; breaking it deletes the warp.

Gravestones: when you die, your items and XP go into a gravestone near the spot, and a Death Waypoint shows how far it is. Break the gravestone to get everything back.

Blueprints: use an Empty Structure Blueprint on two opposite corners of a build (up to 64x256x64), then use it again to save. Or hold an empty one in your off-hand and use a Feather to pick one of 40 ready-made buildings. Sneak and use a blueprint on the Structure Cannon to load it, then use the cannon to place and start it; it builds from chests next to it.

Builder's Wands: extend the surface you look at with matching blocks from your inventory, from 3x3 (stone) to 17x17 (netherite). Sneak and use for settings.

Automation: containers sort themselves when opened, the best tool from your inventory swaps into your hand as you mine, and an axe, pickaxe or hoe breaks whole trees, ore veins or crops at once (sneak to skip). Use a fully grown crop to harvest and replant it, or use a hoe for the whole patch.

Also: Info Board, health bars, damage numbers, Item Magnet, Jumppads, Slime Boots, Miner's Helmets with dynamic light, stickers, holograms, boss bars, kits and player stats. Recipes are in the book.

Type /changelog to see what's new.
